title: The Maharashtra Highways Act
full_text: The Maharashtra Highways Act Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 195555 Act Number: 55 Enactment Date: 1955-12-22 Act Year: 1955 Short Title: The Maharashtra Highways Act Long Title: An Act to provide for the restriction of ribbon development along highways, for the prevention and removal of encroachment thereon, for the construction, maintenance and development of highways, for the levy of betterment charges and for certain other matters. Ministry: Ministry of Govt of Maharashtra Department: Public Works Department Type: STATE Location: Maharashtra Schedule 1.
